why: Cloudflare Pages serves static HTML without the zone cache: every page answered cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC and paid the full Pages round trip on every request (Ahrefs 14 Oct 2026: 41 slow pages, 9 slow responses to AI crawlers; TTFB 541-835 ms in their crawl). This rule makes the site's GET responses cache-eligible; how long each is held comes from the Cache-Control the repo's _headers file sets (s-maxage), so _headers stays the one place that decides freshness. /api/ (Pages Functions: lead capture, click tracking) is excluded and stays dynamic.

rules.description: theindustryguides.com static pages and assets: cache-eligible, TTL from origin Cache-Control; /api/ stays dynamic
